preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= 10**12 for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: Each beauty value x_i is a non-negative integer not larger than 10^12.
The number of beauty values matches the number of vertices.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The result is within the range 0 to 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(gcd(x_u, x_v) for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(1, n+1) if is_ancestor(u, v)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The result is the sum of the greatest common divisors of the beauties of all paths (u, v) where u is an ancestor of v, modulo 10^9 + 7.
